events.label: MLB • Wild Card Series
events.coverage: National postseason window. No Braves or Phillies RSN telecast.
events.notes: Winner-take-all Game 3, series tied 1–1. Atlanta won the opener 5–3; Philadelphia forced a decider with a 4–3 win in 10 innings. The winner opens the NLDS against the Dodgers on Saturday.
events.blackout: U.S. postseason national-rights restrictions apply; MLB.TV does not replace NBC/Peacock live coverage. Local NBC carriage varies by affiliate and provider.

events.label: WNBA • First Round
events.coverage: National cable window. No regional team telecast listed.
events.notes: Winner-take-all Game 3, series tied 1–1. Las Vegas won the opener 102–85; Indiana answered 99–89 behind Caitlin Clark's 25 points and 15 assists. The winner meets Golden State or Dallas in the semifinals.
events.blackout: No territorial blackout is expected. TV-provider access is required; WNBA League Pass restrictions may apply to live national playoff games.

events.label: NFL • Week 4
events.coverage: National Prime Video exclusive. Local over-the-air simulcasts in the Pittsburgh and Cleveland markets.
events.notes: AFC North rivalry with both teams at 2–1. First meeting between new head coaches Mike McCarthy (Pittsburgh) and Todd Monken (Cleveland).
events.blackout: Amazon Prime membership required outside the two home markets. NFL+ mobile restrictions may apply.

events.label: NCAAF • American Conference
events.notes: Tulsa opens American Conference play as a narrow home favorite against a North Texas team led by running back Jahiem White.
events.blackout: No territorial blackout is expected. TV-provider or ESPN streaming access is required.
